segments.an8.80:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kattabbaṃ hoti.
segments.an8.80:1.5: ‘kammaṃ kho me kattabbaṃ bhavissati. Kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilamissati. Handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti.
segments.an8.80:1.6: So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an8.80:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kataṃ hoti.
segments.an8.80:2.3: ‘ahaṃ kho kammaṃ akāsiṃ. Kammaṃ kho pana me karontassa kāyo kilanto. Handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti.
segments.an8.80:2.4: So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an8.80:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā maggo gantabbo hoti.
segments.an8.80:3.3: ‘maggo me gantabbo bhavissati. Maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilamissati. Handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti.
segments.an8.80:3.4: So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an8.80:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā maggo gato hoti.
segments.an8.80:4.3: ‘ahaṃ kho maggaṃ agamāsiṃ. Maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantassa kāyo kilanto. Handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti.
segments.an8.80:4.4: So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an8.80:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto na labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
segments.an8.80:5.3: ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto nālatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa me kāyo kilanto akammañño. Handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti.
segments.an8.80:5.4: So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati … pe … idaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṃ kusītavatthu.
segments.an8.80:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
segments.an8.80:6.3: ‘ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ. Tassa me kāyo garuko akammañño māsācitaṃ maññe. Handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti.
segments.an8.80:6.4: So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati … pe … idaṃ, bhikkhave, chaṭṭhaṃ kusītavatthu.
segments.an8.80:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno uppanno hoti appamattako ābādho.
segments.an8.80:7.3: ‘uppanno kho me ayaṃ appamattako ābādho atthi kappo nipajjituṃ. Handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti.
segments.an8.80:7.4: So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati … pe … idaṃ, bhikkhave, sattamaṃ kusītavatthu.
segments.an8.80:8.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilānā vuṭṭhito [a. ni.6.16 suttavaṇṇanā ṭīkā oloketabbā] hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā.
segments.an8.80:8.3: ‘ahaṃ kho gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. Tassa me kāyo dubbalo akammañño. Handāhaṃ nipajjāmī’ti.
segments.an8.80:8.4: So nipajjati, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an8.80:9.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kattabbaṃ hoti.
segments.an8.80:9.5: ‘kammaṃ kho me kattabbaṃ bhavissati. Kammaṃ kho mayā karontena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ. Handāhaṃ paṭikacceva vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
segments.an8.80:9.6: So vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an8.80:10.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā kammaṃ kataṃ hoti.
segments.an8.80:10.3: ‘ahaṃ kho kammaṃ akāsiṃ. Kammaṃ kho panāhaṃ karonto nāsakkhiṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ. Handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
segments.an8.80:11.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā maggo gantabbo hoti.
segments.an8.80:11.2: Tassa evaṃ hoti – maggo kho me gantabbo bhavissati.
segments.an8.80:11.3: Maggaṃ kho pana me gacchantena na sukaraṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ. Handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ … pe … idaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṃ ārambhavatthu.
segments.an8.80:12.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā maggo gato hoti.
segments.an8.80:12.2: Tassa evaṃ hoti – ahaṃ kho maggaṃ agamāsiṃ.
segments.an8.80:12.3: Maggaṃ kho panāhaṃ gacchanto nāsakkhiṃ buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ manasi kātuṃ. Handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi … pe … idaṃ, bhikkhave, catutthaṃ ārambhavatthu.
segments.an8.80:13.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto na labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
segments.an8.80:13.2: Tassa evaṃ hoti – ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto nālatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
segments.an8.80:13.3: Tassa me kāyo lahuko kammañño. Handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi … pe … idaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṃ ārambhavatthu.
segments.an8.80:14.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto labhati lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
segments.an8.80:14.2: Tassa evaṃ hoti – ahaṃ kho gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya caranto alatthaṃ lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
segments.an8.80:14.3: Tassa me kāyo balavā kammañño. Handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi … pe … idaṃ, bhikkhave, chaṭṭhaṃ ārambhavatthu.
segments.an8.80:15.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno uppanno hoti appamattako ābādho.
segments.an8.80:15.2: Tassa evaṃ hoti – uppanno kho me ayaṃ appamattako ābādho.
segments.an8.80:15.3: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ me ābādho pavaḍḍheyya. Handāhaṃ paṭikacceva vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi … pe … idaṃ, bhikkhave, sattamaṃ ārambhavatthu.
segments.an8.80:16.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilānā vuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā.
segments.an8.80:16.3: ‘ahaṃ kho gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā. Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati yaṃ me ābādho paccudāvatteyya. Handāhaṃ paṭikacceva vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
segments.an8.80:16.4: So vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an8.80:18.1: Dve saddhā dve maraṇassatī, dve sampadā athāpare;

lines: Dasame kusītavatthūnīti kusītassa alasassa vatthūni patiṭṭhā, kosajjakāraṇānīti attho.
Idaṃ paṭhamanti idaṃ “handāhaṃ nipajjāmī”ti evaṃ osīdanaṃ paṭhamaṃ kusītavatthu.
Māsācitakaṃ maññeti ettha pana māsācitaṃ nāma tintamāso.
Yathā tintamāso garuko hoti, evaṃ garukoti adhippāyo.
Gilānā vuṭṭhito hotīti gilāno hutvā pacchā vuṭṭhito hoti.
Dasame kucchitaṃ sīdatīti kusīto da-kārassa ta-kāraṃ katvā.
Yassa dhammassa vasena puggalo “kusīto”ti vuccati, so kusitabhāvo idha kusita-saddena vutto.
Vināpi hi bhāvajotanasaddaṃ bhāvattho viññāyati yathā “paṭassa sukkan”ti, tasmā kusītabhāvavatthūnīti attho.
Taṃ pana caṅkamanavasena karaṇe kāyikantipi vattabbataṃ labhatīti āha “duvidhampī”ti.
Māsehi ācitaṃ nicitaṃ viyāti māsācitaṃ, taṃ maññe.
Yasmā māsā tintā visesena garukā honti, tasmā “yathā tintamāso”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Imināva nayenāti iminā kusītavatthūsu vutteneva nayena “duvidhampi vīriyaṃ ārabhatī”tiādinā.
Idaṃ paṭhamanti “idaṃ, handāhaṃ, vīriyaṃ ārabhāmī”ti,“evaṃ bhāvanāya abbhussahanaṃ paṭhamaṃ ārambhavatthū”tiādinā ca attho veditabbo.
Yathā tathā paṭhamaṃ pavattaṃ abbhussahanañhi upari vīriyārambhassa kāraṇaṃ hoti.
Anurūpapaccavekkhaṇasahitāni hi abbhussahanāni tammūlakāni vā paccavekkhaṇāni aṭṭha ārambhavatthūnīti veditabbāni.
